title: Review impact across exact refs
summary: Compare scoped graph relationships against the base and candidate commits and confirm the important changes in source before using them in review.
acceptance_criteria: Record exact base and candidate SHAs.
Show an affected path that a previous candidate check no longer covers after the base changes.
Validate the finding against the proposed merge and keep the evidence discoverable.

evidence.claim: First Spark provides a candidate case in which a later base dropped a required verifier from the proposed merge.
